text:
Keira Moss: Heads up — VegaCloud opened a billing dispute. They say our May embed totals are ~640k but their sink (third-party webhook) shows ~712k. They suspect our outgoing webhook relay dropped duplicates but their client counts each webhook POST as billable. :thinking:
Jonah Patel: Can you paste the export and client sink counts? Do we bill on ingest or on outbound webhook delivery?
Keira Moss: Our monthly export (embeds_export) shows 639,812 for customer=vegacloud month=2026-05. Vega's sink logs: 712,104 POSTs received. They say discrepancy started after we flipped the new relay worker on 2026-05-14.
Rina Das: Reminder: billing is on successful ingestion (we bill only when ingest_ack emitted). Outbound webhooks are best-effort and can be retried — we don't bill on webhook success. But we need to reconcile why client sees more events.
Keira Moss: Vega provided sample webhook lines showing repeated POSTs with same payload_id but different delivery attempts: 
```
2026-05-20T09:14:02Z POST /webhook 200 payload_id=p-321 attempt=1
2026-05-20T09:14:03Z POST /webhook 200 payload_id=p-321 attempt=2
```
Jonah Patel: That suggests our relay re-sent duplicates (maybe a bug where ack wasn't persisted before responding). Do we have relay request_id vs persisted flag?
Connector Relay Bot: Relay worker v2.4.0 deployed 2026-05-14. Known issue: transient db commit lag could trigger duplicate delivery when ack message not yet durable. Ticket relay-136 opened.
Rina Das: If relay re-delivered identical payloads to customer, their sink counts them twice but our ingestion should only have one ingest_ack if the original ingest succeeded. Need to check whether relay replays happened before or after downstream drop. Also check if ingestion emitted duplicate rows (double-billing) due to replay path.
Keira Moss: I checked ingest_export for May 20 window — we have single ingest_ack per payload_id for p-321 sample. So likely client counted duplicate webhooks while we billed only once. But Vega insists they saw additional unique payload_ids in their sink without corresponding ingest rows.
Jonah Patel: Could the relay have generated new payload_ids on redelivery? e.g., we forward with header X-Relay-ID and Vega treats it as new if header missing. Sample relay logs show: 
```
2026-05-20T09:14:02Z INFO forward payload_id=p-321 relay_id=r-900
2026-05-20T09:14:03Z INFO forward payload_id=p-321 relay_id=r-901
```
Rina Das: If Vega uses payload_id only client-side, duplicates shouldn't create new ids — but some sinks reconstruct event ids from body+timestamp. We should join by payload_hash not relay_id.
Alejandra (Revenue Ops): Financial exposure? Vega is SMB; rough delta ~72k events. At embed price $0.0005 => ~$36. I can approve provisional credit up to $50 while engineering investigates. Please create a ticket.
Billing Bot: Ticket FIN-5346 created: VegaCloud webhook relay duplicates causing client-reported higher counts.
Keira Moss: Opening FIN-5346 now and attaching sample webhook logs and export. Messaging Vega: "We've applied a provisional credit up to $50 while we reconcile; ETA 2 business days."
Jonah Patel: Eng plan: (1) run join between relay delivery logs and ingest_export by payload_hash to see unmatched deliveries, (2) detect whether relay created new payload_ids on retry, (3) if relay caused client-only duplicates, finance reverses nothing; if we double-billed, issue credit. ETA 36 hours for full audit.
Rina Das: Quick SQL we'll run for audit: 
```
SELECT r.payload_id, count(*) AS deliveries, ie.ingest_count
FROM relay_deliveries r
LEFT JOIN (SELECT payload_hash, count(*) AS ingest_count FROM ingest_export WHERE month='2026-05' AND customer='vegacloud' GROUP BY payload_hash) ie
  ON r.payload_hash = ie.payload_hash
WHERE r.customer='vegacloud' AND r.ts BETWEEN '2026-05-14' AND '2026-05-21'
GROUP BY r.payload_id, ie.ingest_count;
```
Keira Moss: Thanks. Alejandra — labeling FIN-5346 "provisional-credit-applied". If final delta is >$100 escalate.
Alejandra (Revenue Ops): Approved. Keep me posted.
Jonah Patel: Will post results in FIN-5346 and here once audit complete. If we find relay bug caused additional billable ingests we'll issue full credit and patch deploy. :wrench:
Keira Moss: Thanks team — will monitor and update. :white_check_mark:
